evidence: Reads attribute-context selectors 0x46 and 0x45. It returns 40 when selector 0x45 is zero; otherwise it returns selector 0x46 unchanged when input bit 0 is set, or selector 0x46 minus 20 when that bit is clear. The caller converts the result to double. decompiled/main/main_0057.c:52143-52165; caller decompiled/main/main_0182.c:50959-50963.

Returns 0xffffffff when the record argument is null. Otherwise it resolves the record pointer from argument+0 (using the lazily initialized fallback when needed), then calls attribute_record_pointer_get_or_default and reads the byte at selected_record+0x48+index when the low-byte index is 0..5; out-of-range indices return 0xff. The caller supplies a 32-bit index and record pointer. decompiled/main/main_0034.c:13936-13958; attribute_record_pointer_get_or_default body decompiled/main/main_0170.c:19034-19042; indexed byte read decompiled/main/main_0170.c:9347-9357; caller decompiled/main/main_0034.c:14314-14317.

Calls initialize_pitch_flight_state on the supplied state object, stores 1 at object+0x310, then tail-calls the next pitch-flight routine. The caller invokes it as part of update_swing_hit_power_vector processing. decompiled/main/main_0158.c:28235-28250; caller decompiled/main/main_0020.c:30913-30917.

Checks the one-time byte at 0x70045f2768 and returns if already initialized. Otherwise it sets that byte to 1, zeroes the first 32-bit fields of the global objects referenced through 0x70022a4208 and 0x70022a4220, then tail-calls process_octetstring_field. The caller invokes it in a sequence of state setup helpers. decompiled/main/main_0164.c:4473-4491; caller decompiled/main/main_0163.c:50288-50293.

Calls attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x14, discards the returned status, and returns constant zero. Its caller uses that zero result as a condition in initialize_context_record_fields. decompiled/main/main_0056.c:36328-36339; caller decompiled/main/main_0088.c:38282-38287; callee name accepted at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:77.
